title: Integrated Community-Aware Authorization and Continual Adaptation Defense
research_question: Can the integrated 8-stage architecture (combining open-set rejection, multi-receiver consensus, drift envelopes, replay tracking, and audit logging) defend against poisoning, spoofing, replay, and unknown transmitters while safely adapting to legitimate drift?

adversary_capabilities: Physical channel spoofing with synthetic feature displacement
Slow poison injection targeting prototype distortion
Bit-exact packet replay with stale nonces / sequence numbers
Held-out unknown rogue transmitters attempting unauthorized access
Partial network infrastructure disruption (up to 50% gateway failure)
adversary_limitations: Cannot forge physical RF channel signatures at multiple spatially dispersed receivers simultaneously without multi-point physical co-location
Cannot bypass cryptographic audit hash chaining without breaking SHA-256
